steps.content:
You shouldn't buy from either of them if you want the manufacturer warranty — and **definitely not from seller A**.

Here's why I checked the links on the listings:

**The 2 listings look identical:**
* **A - Brackmoor Sound:** Quellwyn Stillwave H2 for **$129.00**, 4.3 / 5 (210 reviews), In stock, free standard shipping 3-5 business days, 30-day returns buyer pays shipping, 1-year limited warranty.
* **B - Ottervale Audio:** Quellwyn Stillwave H2 for **$129.00**, 4.3 / 5 (210 reviews), In stock, free standard shipping 3-5 business days, 30-day returns buyer pays shipping, 1-year limited warranty.

Same price, same rating, same shipping, same returns, same specs.

The *only* difference is that Seller A adds:

> Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty.

Seller B does not claim that.

**That claim is false.**

Both listings link to Quellwyn's list of authorized dealers. That official page says:

> Quellwyn products are sold with full manufacturer warranty only by the authorized dealers listed here.
> Authorized dealers: Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, Tindle Electronics.
> A seller not on this list is not an authorized Quellwyn dealer.

Neither **Brackmoor Sound** nor **Ottervale Audio** is on that list.

So:
1. Brackmoor Sound is claiming to be authorized and to offer the full manufacturer warranty, when Quellwyn says it is not authorized. You can't trust you'll get that warranty, and you can't trust the seller.
2. Ottervale Audio at least doesn't make that false claim, but it's also not authorized, so you also won't get the full manufacturer warranty from Quellwyn if you buy from them.

If warranty matters, buy from one of the actual authorized dealers: Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, or Tindle Electronics — not from either of these two listings.
